q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, click "Forgot password" on the sign-in page. We'll email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month. Annual billing saves 20%. You can find more information on our plans in the FAQ.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan is $8 per user per month. For 5 people, it would be $8 * 5 = $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes. You can consider upgrading to Plus or Team for unlimited notes. Details on our plans are available in our FAQ.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: You can get a refund for your Plus subscription since it's within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number. You can email support@example.com for assistance.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: You purchased Plus three weeks ago, which is beyond the 14-day refund window. According to our policy, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. You can contact support with your order number, but a refund may not be possible.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app for Example Notes, but Linux users can access the web app on any modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Example Notes requires Android 12 or later to run, so it is not compatible with Android 11. You may need to upgrade your device to use the app. If you're experiencing issues, I can help you open a support ticket.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app needs a connection to work. You can use the mobile and desktop apps offline, and they will sync automatically when you reconnect. If you need more information, I'd be happy to open a support ticket for you.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export all your notes as PDF, go to Settings > Export and choose PDF. The export will be emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can restore a deleted note by opening Trash, selecting the note, and clicking "Restore". Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, Example Notes does not support SMS for two-factor authentication; it supports authenticator apps instead. You can enable two-factor authentication in Settings > Security. For more information, you can refer to our FAQ or email support@example.com if you have further questions.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the Free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: If you cancel your subscription, you will keep the paid features until the end of the current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your data is stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day. You can email support@example.com to contact us.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%. You can find more information about our plans on our sign-up page or in the app's Settings > Billing section.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices. This is part of the Plus plan features. Annual billing is also available with a 20% discount.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know if we offer a student discount. You can email support@example.com to open a support ticket and ask about it. We'll reply within one business day.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know if Example Notes is HIPAA compliant. You can email support@example.com to open a support ticket and ask about it. We'll reply within one business day.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know if you can import notes from Evernote. You can email support@example.com to open a support ticket for assistance.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't know when the Linux desktop app will be released. You can email support@example.com to open a support ticket for more information.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I'm happy to help with Example Notes-related issues. However, I'm not able to assist with requests unrelated to our note-taking app. You can find many resources online that can help you with writing a Python script to sort a list. If you have any issues with Example Notes, feel free to ask.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I'm here to help with Example Notes-related questions. I'm not able to provide information on the weather; however, I can help with your Example Notes queries. If you have any issues or questions about Example Notes, feel free to ask, or I can offer to open a support ticket for you.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: You can get a refund within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインイン画面で「パスワードを忘れた場合」をクリックしてください。パスワードリセットリンクが記載されたメールが送信されます。有効期限は30分です。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I understand you're frustrated. According to our FAQ, deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days, and you can restore them from there. If you've already checked Trash, I can offer to open a support ticket for you by emailing support@example.com.
